address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I2C address of the digipot. Defaults to `0x2C`.

*See also: [MCP4461 Component](https://next.esphome.io/components/output/mcp4461#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this output component.

*See also: [MCP4461 Component](https://next.esphome.io/components/output/mcp4461#configuration-variables)*

channel.docs:
**string**: Choose the channel of this MCP4461 output component. One of `A`, `B`, `C`, `D`, `E`, `F`, `G` or `H`.

*See also: [MCP4461 Component](https://next.esphome.io/components/output/mcp4461#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this output component.

*See also: [MCP4461 Component](https://next.esphome.io/components/output/mcp4461#configuration-variables)*

initial_value.docs:
**float**: Set initial wiper value, valid range is `0 - 1.0`

*See also: [MCP4461 Component](https://next.esphome.io/components/output/mcp4461#configuration-variables)*

mcp4461_id.docs:
**[ID](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [MCP4461](https://next.esphome.io/components/output/mcp4461#mcp4461-component). Use this if you have multiple MCP4461 ICs you want to use at the same time.

*See also: [MCP4461 Component](https://next.esphome.io/components/output/mcp4461#configuration-variables)*

terminal_a.docs:
**bool**: Set to `false` if terminal "A" shall be disabled on boot. Defaults to `true`

*See also: [MCP4461 Component](https://next.esphome.io/components/output/mcp4461#configuration-variables)*

terminal_b.docs:
**bool**: Set to `false` if terminal "B" shall be disabled on boot. Defaults to `true`

*See also: [MCP4461 Component](https://next.esphome.io/components/output/mcp4461#configuration-variables)*

terminal_w.docs:
**bool**: Set to `false` if terminal "W" shall be disabled on boot. Defaults to `true`

*See also: [MCP4461 Component](https://next.esphome.io/components/output/mcp4461#configuration-variables)*
